# Axis Enterprises (Axis DTF)

> Axis Enterprises supplies and services garment printing machines across India: DTF printers, TPU and PU label printers, digital embroidery and flocking printing. Founded 2006 in Ludhiana, Punjab. More than 1500 installations, 44 industries served since 2013, 21+ machine models, and a 48-person service team across 11 cities that dispatches an engineer within 24 to 48 hours. Machine price band 3 lakh to 16 lakh rupees. Founder and author: Sanjeev Budhiraja.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://axisdtf.com/): what Axis supplies and which technology fits which order book
- [DTF printers](https://axisdtf.com/dtf-printers.html): Nexus 600 6H, 600 mm, 6 i3200 A1 heads, 2400 DPI, CMYK plus white on PET film, with automatic powder shaker
- [TPU label printing](https://axisdtf.com/tpu-label-printing.html): A3 UV Transfer Label DTF Printer, HD 3200 head, 300 mm, CMYK plus white plus varnish on TPU or PU
- [Digital embroidery](https://axisdtf.com/digital-embroidery.html): stitched logo work for caps, uniforms, jackets and bags
- [Flocking printing](https://axisdtf.com/flocking-printing.html): raised velvet finish for fashionwear, kidswear and sportswear
